gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Round, porthole-sized openings in the lowercase give this body a bright, contemporary clarity. Noto Sans Rejang is the anchor, a sans-serif that holds steady beneath the dark, wide-gapped menace of Eater.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Noto Sans Devanagari keeps a compact skyline, with capitals melting into lowercase. Noto Sans Devanagari handles the quiet running lines, while Audiowide stamps out wide-grouted, tile-like glyphs with one plain weight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-ubuntu-sans: Distinctive from the first letter, Gugi cuts its terminals open so the counters flow outward. And where Gugi shows off, Ubuntu Sans settles in with big round-eyed lowercase and tubular, copper-pipe strokes.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk keeps its bowls generous and its terminals refusing to close. Grandstander does the loud work, drawing expressive letters in one unvarying line, while the sans-serif body simply gets on with being approachable.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-bespoke-sans: Rod-like, pipe-cleaner strokes with outsized lowercase proportions make Tektur unmistakable, each curve left generously open at the end. Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined, leaving space where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-alexandria: Tektur draws pipe-cleaner strokes with no calligraphic swell, every curve opening generously at its end. Alexandria brings wide-mouthed curves and a clean, professional build, giving those quirks something steady to rest against.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-amiko: Amiko draws sturdy, modern, crayon-weight strokes, with terminals that point outward like a pair of tongs. Tektur supplies the loud, rod-built counterpart, each stroke cut to a single width.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-bangla: Tektur builds its letters from single-weight rods, with generous openings on every curve and oddly large lowercase. And Anek Bangla keeps paragraphs approachable, with wide s curves barely curled in and short ascenders.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-devanagari: Tektur traces plain, unmodulated outlines with outsized lowercase, giving the strokes a pipe-cleaner personality. Anek Devanagari, with its distinctly open letter mouths, would move through paragraphs smoothly and without fuss.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-latin: Tektur is all single-width rods and generous curve openings. Its place is big and brief, where it gives Anek Latin, with lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, a livelier neighbor.
